name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: From Stormwind, Mathias Shaw sends Gryan Stoutmantle a confidential report at Sentinel Hill. Shaw investigated the former Stonemasons Guild to help Stoutmantle uncover the Defias Brotherhood's origins.

sections.title: A Builder Turned Bandit
sections.body: For months, Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia have faced an uprising across Westfall with no clear face. Highwaymen, thieves, and cutthroats strike along roads and through the countryside. Master Mathias Shaw of SI:7 studies Wiley's Note and pieces together the truth. The guild of architects and stonemasons who rebuilt Stormwind's white ramparts never disbanded. Their leader, Edwin VanCleef, took them underground.

sections.title: Bitterness and Betrayal
sections.body: After the First War left Stormwind in ashes, VanCleef's Stonemasons' Guild set to work restoring the kingdom's capital. Their labor raised Stormwind into a jewel of humanity once more. When the work ended, a bitter dispute over compensation broke out. VanCleef and his artisans were dissatisfied with their treatment by the crown and the House of Nobles. So they took up daggers and red bandanas, leaving civic craft for violent rebellion against the throne.

sections.title: Stoutmantle's Disbelief
sections.body: Shaw's report reaches Sentinel Hill, and Gryan Stoutmantle struggles to accept what it says. He remembers VanCleef as an industrious, gifted artisan, not a cutthroat hiding in the countryside's shadows. VanCleef's work sheltered thousands of returning citizens. The militia commander demands concrete evidence before fully accepting the alarming accusation that Stormwind's chief architect is orchestrating Westfall's ruin.

faq.answer: Mathias Shaw's confidential report contains his findings on the former Stonemasons Guild and the Defias. You carry it to Gryan Stoutmantle.
Edwin VanCleef led the Stonemasons Guild that rebuilt Stormwind. Shaw's report investigates the guild's later history.

faq.q: Why is Gryan Stoutmantle skeptical of the report?
faq.answer: Gryan Stoutmantle finds Shaw's allegations difficult to stomach. He demands concrete evidence before fully accepting them, and the details emerge when he reads the report.

faq.q: Why did the Stonemasons turn against Stormwind?
faq.answer: The Stonemasons rebuilt Stormwind, then fell into a bitter dispute over compensation. They were dissatisfied with their treatment by the crown and the House of Nobles.

faq.q: What role does SI:7 play in this quest?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw of SI:7 investigates possible ties between the former guild and the outlaws, then sends his findings to Stoutmantle.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: You deliver the report, then help Stoutmantle pursue further evidence in the ongoing Defias investigation.

angles.text: For the Alliance, the Stonemasons' rebellion exposes deep fractures within the kingdom. The workers who rebuilt Stormwind's stone ramparts now threaten to tear them down.
As a rogue, you see how disputes among Stormwind's former craftsmen can trouble distant settlements.
As a human of Stormwind, this revelation reaches close to home. The walls of your homes and the Cathedral itself were built by the same men now pillaging the Westfall countryside.
